hook.goal: Create an emotional connection with the dandelion — notice its fluffy white seeds like tiny parachutes waiting to fly
hook.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, personal feeling hook, invitational tone

transition.goal: Invite the child to become a Fluffy Expedition Explorer and find 3 more fluffy, fuzzy, or soft things nearby
transition.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, frame as invitation not command, end with Would you like to...?

rounds.goal: Guide child to find their first fluffy, fuzzy, or soft item nearby
rounds.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, invitational phrasing, suggest touching things
rounds.escalation_note: easy first find — common soft items

rounds.goal: Guide child to find a second soft or fuzzy item
rounds.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, invitational phrasing, celebrate previous find

rounds.goal: Guide child to find one more fluffy or soft item — the third and last one
rounds.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, invitational phrasing, prompt child to go find it
rounds.escalation_note: peak energy — but child still needs to find this item

celebrate.goal: Celebrate the child as a Fluffy Expedition Explorer — they found three soft treasures all connected by fluffiness; connect to IB concept Connection
celebrate.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, name 1 IB concept naturally

closing.goal: Leave the child with a cross-session hook — keep explorer senses open for fluffy and soft things hiding everywhere
closing.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, warm and gentle

synthesis.goal: Look at all fluffy treasures together — notice how softness comes in many forms (fuzzy, silky, puffy) even though they are all soft

early_exit.goal: Gentle goodbye — wonderful fluffy expedition, soft treasures will be waiting for their next adventure
early_exit.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, no pressure to continue

widget_params.description: Dandelion photo centered with seeds gently floating
